name: Antigravity CLI

version_poll.format: HTML, not markdown. One page carries four product panels, `<div class="grid-body" data-list-panel="hub|ide|sdk|cli">`. The default (visible) panel is the Antigravity 2.0 hub, whose versions are 2.x; the CLI panel is `data-list-panel="cli"` and ships hidden (`style="display: none;"`), so read it from the raw HTML rather than from whatever renders first.
version_poll.filter:
inside the `data-list-panel="cli"` panel only, the first `X.Y.Z`; each row's date is the text after that link's `
` (e.g. `September 18, 2026`)
version_poll.transform: version = the `title="View release X.Y.Z"` value (identical to the link text); date = the following text parsed to YYYY-MM-DD
version_poll.reject: any version >= 2.0.0 — that is the hub, IDE or SDK panel, never the CLI

cross_check: HTTP only: the matched row's href must be exactly `/download#antigravity-cli`, its date must be on or after the placemat's `Content synced` date, and every version between the current `.release-tag` and the new one must also appear as a row in the `cli` panel. A run that cannot reach the page fails loudly; it never reports 'nothing newer'.
local_binary: Optional, only where a binary is installed (cloud runs have none and must not treat its absence as a no-op): `agy --version` for the installed version, `agy --help` as ground truth for `card-cli` flags and subcommands at that version
release_notes: Read every `cli` panel row between the current and newest version. Each row has an `<h3>` title, a summary paragraph, and `Improvements (N)` / `Fixes (N)` / `Patches (N)` details lists. Ignore the hub, IDE and SDK panels entirely; keep CLI/TUI and core runtime items.
gotchas: The changelog page's default tab is the Antigravity 2.0 hub (2.15.x and rising); those 2.x versions are NOT the CLI. The CLI lives in the hidden `data-list-panel="cli"` panel, currently 1.2.x. A poll that reads the first version on the page will always see 2.x and either skip the CLI forever or file a bogus 2.x release
Skills and rules follow progressive disclosure (only metadata loaded until activated)
Global rules live in `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`; workspace rules in `.agents/rules/*.md`
Plugin system supports importing packages from both Gemini and Claude ecosystems (`agy plugin import`)
